description_expanded: Escape to Alys Beach in luxury with this beach rental named CzechMate. The home featured in Southern Home Magazine’s March 2018 issue, featuring 3 bedrooms and 3.5 bathrooms. Interiors were selected by, award-winning interior designer, Katie Scott. This stunning home is inviting from the beginning with a captivating entry and stair hall that lead to an elevated main living room. Spanning the width of the home is a great room with 16-foot ceiling and 12-foot doors leading to the courtyard. Across the court, an open-air loggia looks out on the private garden that features a heated pool. The ultimate in privacy, the Primary bedroom and second bedroom each on their own floor, while the third bedroom is a detached guest suite within the carriage house, accessible from the courtyard loggia. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, YOLO coffee, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations.
